_note: Hand-written by Claude from general knowledge of each business on 2026-09-21. No figures on purpose (live figures come from data/companies.json). Business descriptions change slowly, but check a company's own annual report before relying on a detail.

ABB.does: Makes electrical equipment, motors, drives, robots and automation systems for factories, utilities and infrastructure.
ABB.earns: Sells equipment, runs projects and earns service and spares income from industrial and utility customers.
ABB.drivers: Factory and infrastructure capex, order inflow, input costs.

ADANIENSOL.does: Owns high-voltage power transmission lines and runs electricity distribution (including Mumbai) and smart meters.
ADANIENSOL.earns: Earns a regulated tariff on the transmission assets it builds and owns, plus distribution charges.
ADANIENSOL.drivers: New line commissioning, regulator tariff orders, debt cost.

ADANIENT.does: Adani group flagship that runs coal trading and mining services and incubates new businesses: airports, roads, data centres, solar manufacturing, and more.
ADANIENT.earns: Trading margins and mining fees from the mature arm, plus revenue from the infrastructure businesses it builds and later spins out.
ADANIENT.drivers: Coal prices and volumes, airport traffic, funding for new businesses, group-level regulatory news.

ADANIGREEN.does: Builds and runs solar, wind and hybrid power plants.
ADANIGREEN.earns: Sells electricity under long-term contracts at fixed tariffs.
ADANIGREEN.drivers: New capacity added, debt cost, tariff levels, grid and land access.

ADANIPORTS.does: Runs India's largest private network of ports and adds logistics, rail, warehousing and marine services.
ADANIPORTS.earns: Charges for handling cargo and ships at its ports, plus logistics and marine service fees.
ADANIPORTS.drivers: Cargo volumes, trade flows, port tariffs, logistics growth.

ADANIPOWER.does: Generates electricity from coal-fired power plants.
ADANIPOWER.earns: Sells power to state utilities under long-term contracts and to the open market at spot prices.
ADANIPOWER.drivers: Power demand, coal cost and availability, spot power prices, capacity additions.

AMBUJACEM.does: Makes and sells cement and ready-mix concrete; part of the Adani group with ACC and other cement units under it.
AMBUJACEM.earns: The gap between the price of cement per tonne and the cost of making and moving it.
AMBUJACEM.drivers: Construction demand, cement prices, fuel and freight costs, capacity expansion.

APOLLOHOSP.does: Runs hospitals, a large pharmacy chain and digital health services.
APOLLOHOSP.earns: Patient fees at hospitals, medicine retail margins at pharmacies, and diagnostics and digital fees.
APOLLOHOSP.drivers: Hospital occupancy, revenue per bed, new beds, pharmacy growth.

ASIANPAINT.does: Makes decorative and industrial paints, waterproofing and home décor products.
ASIANPAINT.earns: Sells paints through a huge dealer network at a margin over raw-material cost.
ASIANPAINT.drivers: Housing and repainting demand, crude-linked raw material costs, competition from new entrants.

DMART.does: Runs DMart supermarkets selling groceries and daily-use goods at everyday low prices.
DMART.earns: Thin margin on a very large volume of goods; owns much of its store property.
DMART.drivers: New stores, sales per square foot, competition from quick commerce.

AXISBANK.does: Takes deposits and lends to individuals, businesses and corporates; also cards, wealth and investment services.
AXISBANK.earns: Earns the gap between interest on loans and the interest it pays on deposits, plus fees.
AXISBANK.drivers: Loan growth, interest margins, bad loans and credit costs, deposit growth.

BAJAJ-AUTO.does: Makes motorcycles, scooters and three-wheelers for India and export markets.
BAJAJ-AUTO.earns: Vehicle sales, with exports contributing a large share; holds a stake in KTM.
BAJAJ-AUTO.drivers: Domestic demand, export currencies, steel and other input costs, EV transition.

BAJFINANCE.does: Lends to consumers and small businesses: consumer durables, personal, business, mortgage and gold loans.
BAJFINANCE.earns: Interest on loans above its own borrowing cost, plus fees.
BAJFINANCE.drivers: Loan growth, borrowing cost, bad loans, regulatory limits on lending.

BAJAJFINSV.does: Holds the group's financial businesses: Bajaj Finance, Bajaj Allianz general and life insurance, and others.
BAJAJFINSV.earns: Its profit is mainly its share of the profits of those businesses.
BAJAJFINSV.drivers: Bajaj Finance results and insurance growth.

BAJAJHLDNG.does: Holds large stakes in Bajaj Auto, Bajaj Finserv and other group companies.
BAJAJHLDNG.earns: Dividends and gains on its investments; it runs no large operating business of its own.
BAJAJHLDNG.drivers: Share prices and dividends of the companies it holds.

BANKBARODA.does: State-owned bank lending to individuals, businesses and government-linked borrowers, with a large overseas book.
BANKBARODA.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees.
BANKBARODA.drivers: Loan growth, margins, bad loans, government policy.

BEL.does: Makes radars, communication gear, electronic warfare systems and electronics for the armed forces.
BEL.earns: Delivers to defence orders placed by the government and earns on execution over several years.
BEL.drivers: Order book, defence budgets, execution speed.

BPCL.does: Refines crude oil and sells petrol, diesel and LPG through its own pumps.
BPCL.earns: Refining margin (product price minus crude cost) plus marketing margins on fuel sold.
BPCL.drivers: Crude price, refining margins, government control on retail fuel prices.

BHARTIARTL.does: Provides mobile, broadband, DTH and business connectivity in India and Africa.
BHARTIARTL.earns: Monthly subscriber payments; revenue per user is the key number.
BHARTIARTL.drivers: Tariff hikes, subscriber additions, 5G capex, debt.

BOSCHLTD.does: India arm of Bosch: fuel injection and other auto parts, aftermarket, and power tools.
BOSCHLTD.earns: Sells components to car and truck makers and spares to the aftermarket.
BOSCHLTD.drivers: Vehicle production, diesel demand, shift to electric vehicles.

BRITANNIA.does: Makes biscuits, bread, cakes, rusk and dairy products.
BRITANNIA.earns: Sells through distributors and shops at a margin over wheat, palm oil and sugar costs.

CGPOWER.does: Makes transformers, motors, switchgear and railway signalling equipment; has a chip-packaging venture.
CGPOWER.earns: Equipment and project sales to utilities, industry and railways.
CGPOWER.drivers: Grid and industrial capex, order inflow, new chip venture execution.

CANBK.does: State-owned bank lending to individuals and businesses across India.
CANBK.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees.

CHOLAFIN.does: Finances vehicles, home loans against property and small businesses; part of the Murugappa group.
CHOLAFIN.earns: Interest on loans above its funding cost, plus fees.
CHOLAFIN.drivers: Vehicle sales, rural cash flows, bad loans.

CIPLA.does: Makes medicines: respiratory drugs, generics and branded drugs in India, the US, South Africa and other markets.
CIPLA.earns: Sells medicines through doctors, pharmacies and hospitals.
CIPLA.drivers: US generic pricing, India branded growth, drug approvals.

COALINDIA.does: World's largest coal miner; supplies most of India's coal to power plants and industry.
COALINDIA.earns: Coal price times tonnes sold, mostly under long-term supply agreements with power utilities.
COALINDIA.drivers: Power demand, output volume, e-auction prices, wage costs.

CUMMINSIND.does: Makes diesel and gas engines, generator sets and filtration products; India arm of Cummins Inc.
CUMMINSIND.earns: Equipment and spare-part sales for power, mining, rail and construction users.
CUMMINSIND.drivers: Data centre and infra power demand, exports, emission norms.

DLF.does: Builds and sells apartments and rents out offices and malls.
DLF.earns: Apartment sales as projects progress, and steady rent from commercial buildings.
DLF.drivers: Housing demand, launch pipeline, interest rates.

DIVISLAB.does: Makes active ingredients and intermediates for global drug makers, and nutraceutical ingredients.
DIVISLAB.earns: Sells custom and generic ingredients under long-term supply relationships.
DIVISLAB.drivers: Customer orders, drug patent cycles, product mix.

DRREDDY.does: Makes generic medicines, ingredients and biosimilars for the US, India, Europe and emerging markets.
DRREDDY.earns: Sells medicines; US generics are the largest profit source.
DRREDDY.drivers: US generic pricing and launches, rupee, regulatory inspections.

EICHERMOT.does: Makes Royal Enfield motorcycles and, through a joint venture with Volvo, trucks and buses.
EICHERMOT.earns: Motorcycle sales in India and exports plus its share of the commercial vehicle venture.
EICHERMOT.drivers: Motorcycle demand, export markets, input costs.

ETERNAL.does: Runs Zomato food delivery, Blinkit quick commerce, Hyperpure supplies and going-out services.
ETERNAL.earns: Commissions, delivery and platform fees, advertising and product margins.
ETERNAL.drivers: Order volumes, delivery costs, competition, losses on new businesses.

GAIL.does: Transports and sells natural gas, and makes LPG and polymers.
GAIL.earns: Pipeline tariffs, gas trading margins and petrochemical sales.
GAIL.drivers: Gas prices and volumes, petrochemical spreads.

GODREJCP.does: Makes household insecticides, soaps, hair colour and personal care products in India, Indonesia and Africa.
GODREJCP.earns: Sells branded products through distributors at a margin over raw material cost.
GODREJCP.drivers: Palm oil and other input costs, rural demand, overseas currencies.

GRASIM.does: Aditya Birla group company that makes viscose fibre and chemicals, holds the UltraTech cement business, and has entered paints.
GRASIM.earns: Sales from fibre and chemicals plus its share of cement profits; new paints business is still investing.
GRASIM.drivers: Cement and chemical prices, paints start-up losses.

HCLTECH.does: Provides IT, engineering and software services to global companies, and sells its own software products.
HCLTECH.earns: Bills clients for services by time or fixed price, plus software licence income.
HCLTECH.drivers: Client tech spending, US and Europe demand, rupee, wage costs.

HDFCAMC.does: Manages HDFC mutual fund schemes for investors.
HDFCAMC.earns: A fee as a percentage of the money it manages (assets under management).
HDFCAMC.drivers: Market levels, SIP inflows, fee regulation.

HDFCBANK.does: India's largest private bank: deposits, loans, cards and payments for individuals and businesses.
HDFCBANK.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees.
HDFCBANK.drivers: Loan and deposit growth, margins, bad loans.

HDFCLIFE.does: Sells life insurance, savings and pension products.
HDFCLIFE.earns: Premiums collected, invested until claims are paid; profit comes from margin on new policies and investment income.
HDFCLIFE.drivers: New business growth, product mix, tax and regulation on insurance.

HINDALCO.does: Makes aluminium and copper in India and owns Novelis, a large US-based aluminium rolling company.
HINDALCO.earns: Metal price (set on global exchanges) minus cost of power, coal and raw material, plus conversion fees at Novelis.
HINDALCO.drivers: Aluminium and copper prices, energy costs, Novelis volumes.

HAL.does: Builds and repairs military aircraft, helicopters and engines for the Indian armed forces.
HAL.earns: Delivers on government defence orders over many years and earns overhaul and repair fees.
HAL.drivers: Order book, delivery timelines, defence budget.

HINDUNILVR.does: Makes soaps, detergents, shampoo, tea, foods and beauty products; India arm of Unilever.
HINDUNILVR.earns: Sells branded products through distributors and shops at a margin over raw material cost.
HINDUNILVR.drivers: Volume growth, palm oil and crude-linked input costs, competition.

HINDZINC.does: Mines and smelts zinc, lead and silver; part of the Vedanta group.
HINDZINC.earns: Metal price times volume, minus mining and smelting costs.
HINDZINC.drivers: Zinc and silver prices, mine output, rupee.

HYUNDAI.does: Makes and sells passenger cars and SUVs in India (such as Creta) and exports; subsidiary of Hyundai Motor Company.
HYUNDAI.drivers: Car demand, new launches, input costs, royalty paid to parent.

ICICIBANK.does: Takes deposits and lends to individuals, businesses and corporates; also insurance and asset management stakes.
ICICIBANK.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees.

ITC.does: Sells cigarettes, packaged foods and personal care, and makes paperboard and agri products; hotels were split into a separate listed company.
ITC.earns: Cigarettes generate most of the profit; foods and other FMCG are growing but earn lower margins.
ITC.drivers: Cigarette tax changes, volumes, FMCG margins.

INDHOTEL.does: Runs Taj and other hotel brands, owned and managed.
INDHOTEL.earns: Room and food revenue, plus fees for managing hotels owned by others.
INDHOTEL.drivers: Room rates, occupancy, new hotel signings.

IOC.does: India's largest refiner and fuel seller; also runs pipelines and petrochemicals.
IOC.earns: Refining margin plus marketing margins on fuel sold.
IOC.drivers: Crude prices, refining margins, government control on retail fuel prices.

IRFC.does: Borrows from markets and leases railway assets to Indian Railways.
IRFC.earns: A small fixed spread over its borrowing cost on leases to Indian Railways.

INFY.does: Provides IT, consulting and digital services to global companies.
INFY.earns: Bills clients for services by time or fixed price.
INFY.drivers: Client tech spending, US and Europe demand, rupee, wage costs.

INDIGO.does: India's largest airline, operating domestic and international passenger flights.
INDIGO.earns: Ticket sales plus fees for baggage, seats and other extras.
INDIGO.drivers: Fuel price, rupee, ticket prices, aircraft supply.

JSWSTEEL.does: Makes flat and long steel products for construction, autos and industry.
JSWSTEEL.earns: The spread between steel price and the cost of iron ore and coking coal.
JSWSTEEL.drivers: Steel prices, coking coal cost, imports, capacity expansion.

JINDALSTEL.does: Makes steel and rails and owns mines and power capacity.
JINDALSTEL.earns: The spread between steel price and raw material cost, plus power sales.
JINDALSTEL.drivers: Steel prices, iron ore and coal costs, expansion capex.

JIOFIN.does: Lending, payments and insurance-broking arm split out from Reliance; also asset management with BlackRock.
JIOFIN.earns: Interest on loans it gives, plus fees and share of joint venture income.
JIOFIN.drivers: Loan book growth, funding cost, joint venture scale-up.

KOTAKBANK.does: Takes deposits and lends; also broking, asset management and insurance.
KOTAKBANK.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees from group businesses.
KOTAKBANK.drivers: Loan growth, margins, bad loans, regulatory limits.

LTM.does: IT and digital services company (the successor to LTIMindtree as listed by NSE).
LTM.earns: Bills clients for services by time or fixed price.
LTM.drivers: Client tech spending, deal wins, wage costs.

LT.does: Builds infrastructure, plants and defence equipment; also IT services and financial services.
LT.earns: Revenue from projects as they are executed, tracked through its order book.
LT.drivers: Order inflow, project execution, commodity costs, Middle East business.

LODHA.does: Builds and sells residential apartments, mainly in Mumbai and Pune, with some commercial projects.
LODHA.earns: Apartment sales (pre-sales) and rentals from commercial assets.
LODHA.drivers: Housing demand, launches, land cost, interest rates.

M&M.does: Makes SUVs, tractors, commercial vehicles and runs a finance arm; holds stakes in other group businesses.
M&M.earns: Vehicle and tractor sales plus its share of finance and other subsidiaries.
M&M.drivers: SUV demand, monsoon and farm income, input costs.

MARUTI.does: India's largest carmaker; subsidiary of Suzuki Motor.
MARUTI.earns: Car sales through dealers and after-sales parts.
MARUTI.drivers: Small-car demand, model launches, commodity costs, yen.

MAXHEALTH.does: Runs a network of hospitals mainly in north and central India.
MAXHEALTH.drivers: Bed additions, occupancy, revenue per bed.

MAZDOCK.does: Builds warships and submarines for the Indian Navy and repairs ships.
MAZDOCK.earns: Contract revenue recognised as ships are built, over many years.
MAZDOCK.drivers: Order book, delivery schedules, defence spending.

MUTHOOTFIN.earns: Interest on gold loans above its own funding cost.
MUTHOOTFIN.drivers: Gold price, loan growth, regulation on gold loans.

NTPC.does: India's largest power generator, with thermal and growing renewable capacity.
NTPC.earns: Regulated fixed charge for capacity plus an energy charge for power delivered under long-term contracts.
NTPC.drivers: Plant availability, regulated returns, renewable build-out, coal supply.

NESTLEIND.does: Makes Maggi, Nescafe, KitKat, milk products and infant foods; Nestle group company.
NESTLEIND.earns: Sells branded foods at a margin over raw material cost; pays royalty to parent.
NESTLEIND.drivers: Volume growth, dairy and coffee costs, royalty changes.

ONGC.does: India's largest crude oil and natural gas producer, with overseas assets.
ONGC.earns: Price of crude and gas times volume produced.
ONGC.drivers: Crude prices, output, government levies on producers.

PIDILITIND.does: Makes adhesives, sealants and construction chemicals under brands such as Fevicol.
PIDILITIND.earns: Sells through retailers and contractors at a healthy margin over raw material cost.

PFC.does: Lends to power generation, transmission and distribution companies; also owns REC.
PFC.earns: Interest on loans above its own borrowing cost.
PFC.drivers: Power-sector loan growth, funding cost, bad loans.

POWERGRID.does: Owns and runs India's national high-voltage power grid.
POWERGRID.earns: A regulated tariff for keeping the grid available, not tied to how much power flows.
POWERGRID.drivers: New line commissioning, regulated return rate, capex.

PNB.does: State-owned bank lending to individuals and businesses.
PNB.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees.

RECLTD.does: Lends to power and infrastructure companies; owned by PFC.
RECLTD.earns: Interest on loans above its own borrowing cost.
RECLTD.drivers: Loan growth, funding cost, bad loans.

RELIANCE.does: Runs oil refining and petrochemicals, Jio telecom, Reliance Retail, and new energy and media businesses.
RELIANCE.earns: Refining margins, mobile subscriber fees, retail sales and digital services.
RELIANCE.drivers: Refining margins, Jio tariffs, retail growth, new energy investment.

SBILIFE.does: Sells life insurance, savings and pension products, mainly through SBI branches.
SBILIFE.earns: Premiums collected and invested; profit comes from margin on new policies and investment income.
SBILIFE.drivers: New business growth, product mix, tax and regulation on insurance.

MOTHERSON.does: Makes wiring harnesses, mirrors, bumpers and modules for carmakers worldwide.
MOTHERSON.earns: Supplies parts to carmakers under multi-year contracts.
MOTHERSON.drivers: Global car production, customer concentration, acquisitions and debt.

SHREECEM.does: Makes and sells cement, mainly in north and east India, and generates some power.
SHREECEM.earns: The gap between cement price per tonne and the cost of making and moving it.
SHREECEM.drivers: Cement prices, fuel and freight, demand.

SHRIRAMFIN.does: Finances used commercial vehicles and small businesses and gives consumer loans.
SHRIRAMFIN.earns: Interest on loans above its own borrowing cost, plus fees.
SHRIRAMFIN.drivers: Truck demand, funding cost, bad loans.

ENRIN.does: Makes and services power generation and grid equipment such as turbines and transformers; split out of Siemens Ltd.
ENRIN.earns: Equipment sales, projects and service contracts.
ENRIN.drivers: Power and grid capex, order inflow, execution.

SIEMENS.does: Provides factory automation, smart infrastructure and rail mobility products and services.
SIEMENS.earns: Product sales, projects and services to industry, buildings and railways.

SOLARINDS.does: Makes industrial explosives for mining and defence products and ammunition.
SOLARINDS.earns: Sells explosives to mining companies and munitions and systems to defence customers.
SOLARINDS.drivers: Coal and mining volumes, defence orders, exports.

SBIN.does: India's largest bank, with deposits, loans and subsidiaries in insurance, cards and asset management.
SBIN.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees and subsidiary profits.
SBIN.drivers: Loan growth, margins, bad loans, government policy.

SUNPHARMA.does: India's largest drugmaker: branded medicines in India, generics in the US and specialty drugs.
SUNPHARMA.earns: Sells medicines; specialty and India brands give the highest margins.
SUNPHARMA.drivers: US specialty drug growth, generic pricing, regulatory issues.

TVSMOTOR.does: Makes motorcycles, scooters, three-wheelers and electric vehicles for India and export.
TVSMOTOR.drivers: Two-wheeler demand, exports, EV transition, input costs.

TATACAP.does: Tata group lender: consumer, small business and corporate loans, plus wealth and other financial services.
TATACAP.earns: Interest on loans above its own borrowing cost, plus fees.
TATACAP.drivers: Loan growth, funding cost, bad loans.

TCS.does: India's largest IT services company, serving global banks, retailers, manufacturers and others.
TCS.earns: Bills clients for services by time or fixed price.
TCS.drivers: Client tech spending, deal wins, rupee, wage costs.

TATACONSUM.does: Makes and sells Tata Tea, Tetley, Tata Salt and other foods; is also a partner in the Starbucks venture in India.
TATACONSUM.earns: Sells branded products through distributors and shops.
TATACONSUM.drivers: Tea and other input prices, volume growth.

TMCV.does: Makes trucks, buses and other commercial vehicles after the Tata Motors demerger.
TMCV.drivers: Freight demand, infrastructure spending, steel cost, interest rates.

TMPV.type: Auto maker (passenger vehicles and Jaguar Land Rover)
TMPV.does: Makes Tata cars and electric vehicles in India and owns Jaguar Land Rover in the UK.
TMPV.earns: Vehicle sales, with Jaguar Land Rover a major profit source.
TMPV.drivers: Car demand, JLR sales and margins, EV competition, pound and dollar.

TATAPOWER.does: Generates power (thermal and renewable), runs distribution in several cities, and builds solar projects and EV charging.
TATAPOWER.earns: Regulated returns on utility assets and sales from renewable and solar businesses.
TATAPOWER.drivers: Renewable capacity added, tariffs, coal costs.

TATASTEEL.does: Makes steel in India, the Netherlands and the UK.
TATASTEEL.earns: The spread between steel price and the cost of iron ore and coking coal.
TATASTEEL.drivers: Steel prices, coking coal, European operations.

TECHM.does: Provides IT and business services, with a strong base in telecom clients.
TECHM.earns: Bills clients for services by time or fixed price.
TECHM.drivers: Telecom sector spending, client demand, margins.

TITAN.does: Sells jewellery under Tanishq, and watches, eyewear and fragrances.
TITAN.earns: Retail sales of jewellery, which carries a modest margin over gold cost, plus higher-margin watches and eyewear.
TITAN.drivers: Gold price, wedding season demand, store additions.

TORNTPHARM.does: Makes medicines, mainly chronic-disease branded generics in India, with Brazil, Germany and US sales.
TORNTPHARM.earns: Sells medicines through doctors and pharmacies.
TORNTPHARM.drivers: India brand growth, acquisitions, US and Europe pricing.

TRENT.does: Runs Westside and Zudio fashion stores and Star grocery stores.
TRENT.earns: Retail sales at a margin over cost of goods; Zudio is the growth engine.
TRENT.drivers: Store additions, same-store sales, consumer demand.

ULTRACEMCO.does: India's largest cement maker, part of the Aditya Birla group.
ULTRACEMCO.earns: The gap between cement price per tonne and the cost of making and moving it.
ULTRACEMCO.drivers: Cement prices, fuel and freight, capacity expansion.

UNIONBANK.does: State-owned bank lending to individuals and businesses.
UNIONBANK.earns: Interest margin between loans and deposits, plus fees.

UNITDSPR.does: Makes and sells whisky and other spirits; majority owned by Diageo.
UNITDSPR.earns: Sells branded spirits through state-controlled distribution channels.
UNITDSPR.drivers: State excise policy, premium brand mix, grain and glass costs.

VBL.does: Makes and distributes PepsiCo soft drinks and other beverages in India, Africa and other regions.
VBL.earns: Sells beverages to distributors and retailers at a margin over sugar, packaging and concentrate costs.
VBL.drivers: Summer demand, sugar and PET costs, franchise terms.

VEDL.does: Mines and sells aluminium, zinc (through Hindustan Zinc), oil and gas, iron ore and other metals.
VEDL.earns: Commodity price times volume minus operating cost; parent depends on dividends from subsidiaries.
VEDL.drivers: Aluminium, zinc and oil prices, debt repayments, dividend flow from subsidiaries.

WIPRO.does: Provides IT, consulting and business process services to global companies.
WIPRO.earns: Bills clients for services by time or fixed price.
WIPRO.drivers: Client tech spending, deal wins, wage costs.

ZYDUSLIFE.does: Makes generic medicines for the US, branded drugs in India and consumer products such as Sugar Free.
ZYDUSLIFE.drivers: US generic pricing and launches, India growth, regulatory inspections.
